entries.dialogueText: Government facilities in a handful of smaller towns have been seized, sparking street riots as citizens demand change. The situation has escalated far beyond calling it mere unrest."

entries.dialogueText: “Well, then what would you call it?”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“I'd call it, a revolution.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'd call it, a revolution.”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“Or at the very least, the makings..."
entries.dialogueText: “Or at the very least, the makings of one.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Titus, I think you're blowing this..."
entries.dialogueText: “Titus, I think you're blowing this out of proportion.”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“I can assure you, I'm not. We’re s..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can assure you, I'm not. We’re seeing a turning point that we can no longer ignore.”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“I've already made arrangements for..."
entries.dialogueText: “I've already made arrangements for myself in case this worst-case scenario comes to pass, and advise you to do the same.”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""A storm is coming, Your Majesty. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "A storm is coming, Your Majesty. There's no doubt about it. How you prepare for it is up to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your concern is duly noted, Captai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your concern is duly noted, Captain. However, I have weathered many storms in my time as king, and I will not falter now."

entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“Actually, there is a matter that m..."
entries.dialogueText: “Actually, there is a matter that may require your attention."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I've been receiving anonymous tips..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been receiving anonymous tips and warnings from informants within the court and from sources outside the kingdom who speak of growing discontent with the current leadership."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Discontent? From within our own co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Discontent? From within our own court?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see... It seems trust is becomin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see... It seems trust is becoming a rare commodity these days. What else can you tell me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't tolerate betrayal from wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't tolerate betrayal from within my own court. Can you tell me who these traitor are? We need to get to the bottom of this treachery."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes, sir. These sources hint at po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, sir. These sources hint at potential changes in leadership, but don't disclose which noble houses are involved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Anonymous sources... unnamed nobl..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Anonymous sources... unnamed noble houses... Sorry, but I don't take cryptically vague threats very seriously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is troubling news. Continue t..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is troubling news. Continue to gather any and all information that you can, Titus. We must stay vigilant."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It's a matter not to be taken ligh..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a matter not to be taken lightly."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""From what I've gathered, my source..."
entries.dialogueText: "From what I've gathered, my sources hint at potential changes in leadership, but don't disclose which noble houses are involved."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "My informants haven't disclosed the..."
entries.dialogueText: My informants haven't disclosed the specific noble houses involved -- rather, they've only mentioned a growing discussion about a potential leadership change."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""This may not sound like much, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "This may not sound like much, but I can assure you that my informants are reliable, and what they've uncovered shouldn't be taken lightly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sounds like someone's been reading..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds like someone's been reading too many spy thrillers. But in all seriousness, if there's even a hint of truth to these whispers, we must act swiftly."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes, sir. Before I go, I would be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, sir. Before I go, I would be remiss if I didn't inform you that I've already made arrangements for myself in case this worst-case scenario comes to pass, and would advise you to do the same."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“I assure you, this threat is very..."
entries.dialogueText: “I assure you, this threat is very real. We’re seeing a turning point that we can no longer ignore.”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "Very well. But before I go, I would..."
entries.dialogueText: Very well. But before I go, I would be remiss if I didn't inform you that I've already made arrangements for myself in case this worst-case scenario comes to pass, and would advise you to do the same."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks for the weather report, Tit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the weather report, Titus. I'll make sure to pack an umbrella."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks, but I didn't ask for unsol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks, but I didn't ask for unsolicited advice. You're excused, Captain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate your concern, Titus...."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your concern, Titus. I'll take it into consideration."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Funny you should mention it... it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Funny you should mention it... it just so happens that I took the liberty of inviting Lucita to meet us for that very purpose."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He checked his watch."
entries.dialogueText: He checked his watch.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""And, actually, should be arriving..."
entries.dialogueText: "And, actually, should be arriving any minute--"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""And speaking of unexpected revelat..."
entries.dialogueText: "And speaking of unexpected revelations, there's someone here who can hopefully shed some light on the matter."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Well, if you don't believe me, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, if you don't believe me, then maybe you'll believe what Lucita has to say for herself, who I invited here and should be arriving shortly."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm glad you brought that up becau..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you brought that up because that brings up another matter that deserves your immediate attention."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I felt compelled to share with you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I felt compelled to share with you the findings of our investigation into your uncle and Grand Vizier, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""It all began with eyewitness accou..."
entries.dialogueText: "It all began with eyewitness accounts, including my own, placing Hugo exiting the late King’s private chambers just before his death."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""There's been a lingering conspirac..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's been a lingering conspiracy theory surrounding Hugo, suggesting he sees himself as the rightful king."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""This alone provided a motive for s..."
entries.dialogueText: "This alone provided a motive for suspicion, not to mention the rumored bitter rivalry between them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, as I delved deeper, I unc..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, as I delved deeper, I uncovered a surprising truth."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Hugo and King Valero shared a clos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hugo and King Valero shared a close bond, evident through their correspondence and numerous testimonials."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""There was no evidence of Hugo aspi..."
entries.dialogueText: "There was no evidence of Hugo aspiring to claim the throne. The supposed rivalry was a mere fiction."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Regarding the night of Valero’s de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regarding the night of Valero’s demise, I found no traces linking Hugo to any murder weapon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""When the late king was exhumed, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the late king was exhumed, a preserved sample of formalin-fixed tissue allowed for an advanced toxicology examination by Iza University's laboratories."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""You might be surprised to learn th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You might be surprised to learn that traces of Mandragora -- a deadly nightshade --were found in the late king's system during a recent toxicology test."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, despite our exhaustive ef..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, despite our exhaustive efforts, there's no evidence linking Hugo to the possession or acquisition of such a poison. It appears to be a case of him being at the wrong place at the wrong time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I hope this information proves use..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope this information proves useful to you, Your Majesty, as you continue to seek answers and closure regarding your father's untimely passing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I must bring to your attention the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must bring to your attention the progress made in our investigation concerning Lucita."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""While our efforts yielded signific..."
entries.dialogueText: "While our efforts yielded significant findings, they only extended as far as the toxicology report."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Initially, suspicions were raised..."
entries.dialogueText: "Initially, suspicions were raised due to the presence of Mandragora—a lethal nightshade—in your father's toxicology report."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""However, we were unable to uncover..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, we were unable to uncover any tangible evidence linking Lucita to the acquisition or possession of such a poison."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Respectfully, Captain Titus Gor..."
entries.dialogueText:
"Respectfully,

Captain Titus Gordion"
